configuration: The three K1/K2/K3 parameter cases and cubic, triclinic, and FCC unit-cell comparisons from upstream test_periodic_images_1, SAB_REPEATS=1.
observable: L2-normalized periodic K1 atomic-number, K2 inverse-distance, and K3 cosine MBTR arrays for the official cubic/triclinic cells, their 2x1x1 supercells, and three equivalent FCC cells.
default_vs_upstream: Nominal transcribes all three upstream parameter cases, the cubic and triclinic cell/supercell pairs, the three upstream hydrogen FCC structures, and their descriptor settings exactly; Harbor only serializes the arrays and adds the calibration scale and repeat knob.
variant: ic/variant changes the cell and lattice scale from 1.0 to 1.0000000000000004 (two binary64 ulps); nominal therefore remains exactly the upstream geometries.
altbuild: none: the Debian image intentionally carries one GCC build; no independent alternative-build floor is available.

evidence.floor_how: No alternative-build floor is available; nominal-versus-variant Docker self-validation supplies the spread recorded in self_validation_spread.

warrant: Every physically indexed histogram bin produced by the official K1, K2, and K3 periodic-image cases is compared pointwise at finalized atol=1e-8 and rtol=1e-6. Dropping periodic replicas, applying an incorrect cell transform, or omitting L2 normalization changes populated bins at a scale far above this bound. The bound is achievable because the deterministic float64 Docker calibration moved by only 4.052314039881821e-15 under the two-ULP cell perturbation; the human finalized the common descriptor bound after the nominal case was restored to the pinned upstream test.
